summary:
Not ON PAR (6.5/10). Three majors are confirmed (splash, secondary motion, form finish), one major is downgraded to minor (skins), and one minor is added (face). There is no sensitivity blocker.

What holds:
- The silhouette hook is real. Max IoU64 against any other fighter is 0.646 (Odrum), from art/renders/lineup/integ_chars_p2.json.
- She separates from the lane by value: figure L* p50 66 against lane 39 (_harness/_reports/closing_ulkro_lane_sep.json).
- The run has the second-longest stride for her height.

Sensitivity is clean:
- The hood is a rounded cowl that sits close to the head. Its RoundCone tip tops out at 1.860 m, against the ellipsoid crown at 1.843 m (art/blender/fighters/ulkro.py:452-454). The model is rounder than the concept's peaked hood (_design/concept/ulkro.webp). In the match frames it reads as a dome (closing_ulkro_game_red_t150_x4.png).
- The face is a canon Hourless wrap (WORLD.md:43). It is cloth with folds and a nose bump, not a hockey mask or a mannequin.

What I measured myself:
- Independent GLB skinning (_harness/_reports/closing_ulkro_verify_glb.txt) reproduces the death hold exactly: 682 body verts below -3 cm, shin.R -0.202 m, foot.R -0.205 m.
- The GLB has 32 joints. Its only x_ channels are x_dart scale (attacks, cast_a1) and x_crest0-4 (death).
- Splash grain: figure 4.7 against plate 0.5-0.6 (_harness/_reports/closing_ulkro_verify_splash_grain.txt).

Severity corrections:
- M4 drops to minor. Skins as palette/material swaps are the owner's binding ruling. Highrim's game-camera delta sits mid-roster (p50 dE 6.8; ardit, ervet, sukri, tunlan and vashil are lower, per _harness/_reports/closing_ulkro_verify_skin_delta_roster.txt). Long Evening's brief never asks for a vfxTint, and 11 of 16 deluxe skins have none. The splash reuse is already counted in M1.
- Within M3, the pauldron colour is on-brief: stone #B3AEA2 is L*71 at 9 %, and the match measures L*70-75 at 10-12 %. The concept's quiver is itself a pale wrapped flat case. Those two sub-claims are refuted; the wraps, boots, glass and smudges stand.
- Within M2, the 20 cm death sink is roster-wide: 10 of 16 death holds sink 10 cm or more, and Ulkro is mid-pack (_harness/_reports/closing_ulkro_verify_death_floor_roster.txt). Alone it would be a minor. M2 stands on the rigid knee-length skirt, which boards over the thigh in the run, matching kemdo-M4, ardit-M3 and nurrow-M3.

gapStatus.id: Secondary clips: darts do not spill in death; run thigh shows over the skirt
gapStatus.evidence:
The reviewer's 'still_open' understates this; it is half fixed.
- Fixed: death keys translation and rotation on x_crest0-4 (_harness/_reports/closing_ulkro_verify_glb.txt), and the darts lie along the ground in closing_ulkro_clip_death_end_x4.png.
- Open: the run has no x_ channels, and the front skirt panel still boards up over the dark thigh (closing_ulkro_clip_run_x3.png, bottom row).
- The death floor sink is real (-0.205 m) but roster-wide, so it is tracked under M2.

gapStatus.id: Splash pauldrons backlit into dark brown boards
gapStatus.evidence: The dark brown-board read is gone, as the reviewer concedes. The W5b regrade of 10-29 00:14 leaves the plates purple-grey at L* 33-39 (closing_ulkro_splash_measure.txt), and the raised arms hide most of them (closing_ulkro_splash_upper_3skins_x1.5.png). That is better than the original defect but still dark against the pale-stone brief, so 'partly' rather than 'still_open'.

gapStatus.id: Pauldrons in the three.js views are thinner and mid-grey compared with the concept's broad pale plates
gapStatus.evidence: ulkro.glb is unchanged since 10-27 20:55, and the front close of three_ulkro.png samples L* 61-63. In the match they render at L* 70-75 and saturation 10-12 %. That matches the brief's stone #B3AEA2 (L* 71, 9 %), so the colour part is on-brief. The thin-plate form against the concept's broad two-tier plates remains.

gapStatus.id: Highrim hood and sleeves lean olive-khaki in shade
gapStatus.evidence: Confirmed fixed. The three.js Highrim sleeve is #9A927E (hue 43, 18 %). The re-graded Highrim splash sleeves sample hue 29-37, a warm sand, not olive (closing_ulkro_splash_measure.txt; closing_ulkro_skins_close.png).

gapStatus.id: Accent 0.48% is under the pipeline's 1.5% warning floor (warning only, gates pass)
gapStatus.evidence:
Confirmed:
- build_report_ulkro.json three_qa.accentPct is 0.48;
- integ_chars_p2.json gives ulkro accentPctMax 0.16 with accentOk false (and valueGradientOk false).

The brief itself budgets 'about 0.3%' (_design/fighters/ulkro.md:103), so the low accent is a brief-level choice, not a build regression. Team identity in the match still comes from the ring and the bar.

findings.title: Splash and portraits are grainy model renders on painted plates, in one stiff frontal stand reused by all three skins
findings.what: All three splashes are the same frontal victory stand, framed the same way: parallel legs, one hand at the brow, the crest fanning to screen-left although the brief asks for screen-right. The figure is a Cycles render on a painted plate. Its grain, ring wraps, bulb boots and smeared projected tunic strokes do not match the plate's brushwork. The portraits are one pose recoloured on three plates.
findings.evidence:
Re-measured on art/out/fighters/ulkro/*splash.png (10-29 00:14):
- figure interior high-pass sigma 4.73-4.76, against plate sky 0.54-0.64;
- luma max 204-207 (_harness/_reports/closing_ulkro_verify_splash_grain.txt).

A grid scan shows figure cells at 4-9 and plate cells at 0.2-1.0.

Viewed: _harness/_shots/closing_ulkro_splashes_3up.png (same pose and framing three times), closing_ulkro_splash_torso_legs_x3.png (smears, ring wraps, bulb boots) and closing_ulkro_portraits_3up.png.

The brief's 'toward screen-right' is at _design/fighters/ulkro.md:176.
findings.gauge: A LoL champion's splash is a bespoke painted illustration with a staged action beat. Figure and backdrop share light and brushwork, and each skin has its own composition, with portraits cut from it.
findings.fix:
- Stage the Run-up release on the high rim at dusk: low stride, thrower drawn back, the laid dart's dawnglass catching the sun as the key light.
- Light the figure from the plate's sun, denoise the figure pass and add a painted-over pass.
- Give each skin its own composition: Highrim on a side-lit strata cliff at noon; Long Evening with the lacquer fan backlit by festival lanterns.
- Cut each skin's portrait from its own splash pass, and turn the crest to screen-right.
findings.files: art/blender/fighters/ulkro.py (SPLASH, per-skin splash poses), art/blender/common/plates.py, art/blender/common/render.py, art/out/fighters/ulkro/*splash.png, *portrait.png
findings.verifierNote: Reproduced: the grain gap is 7-8x, all three cards share one pose, and the crest faces screen-left against the brief. The pipeline is roster-wide, but every other closing verifier confirmed this as a major for their fighter (ardit-M1, kemdo-M3, nurrow-M1, rishal-M1, tunlan-C3), so severity holds.

findings.title: No secondary motion: the knee-length skirt boards up over the thigh in the run, and the hood-tail and sash are rigid; the death hold sinks the right leg 20 cm
findings.what:
The rig has 32 joints and no cloth chains. The only x_ channels are x_dart scale and the death-only x_crest0-4.
- The knee-length skirt is skinned to the thighs, so in the run the front panel lifts as a rigid board and the dark thigh shows across it.
- The 0.38 m hood-tail ribbon and the sash never lag or settle.
- The held death frame sinks shin.R and foot.R about 0.20 m into the floor, and mid-fall the laid dart reaches 0.27 m below ground.
findings.evidence:
Independent probe (_harness/_reports/closing_ulkro_verify_glb.txt; scratchpad glbskin.py, linear-blend skinning, quantization aware):
- death t=1.50 s: 682 verts below -3 cm, shin.R -0.202, foot.R -0.205, thigh.R -0.107, hips -0.067;
- t=0.75 s: x_dart -0.267;
- run: the body stays within -0.004 m of the ground and has no x_ channels.

The runtime holds the last death frame (src/render/actors.ts:1008-1009, clampWhenFinished), and there is no procedural cloth in src.

Shots: _harness/_shots/closing_ulkro_clip_run_x3.png (bottom row boarding) and closing_ulkro_clip_death_end_x4.png (stub right boot).

Roster: 10 of 16 base GLBs sink 10 cm or more in their death hold (_harness/_reports/closing_ulkro_verify_death_floor_roster.txt).
findings.gauge: On a LoL champion, a long skirt, sash or hood-tail lags, overshoots and settles on stops, dashes and death, and stays in front of the legs in the run. Death poses rest on the ground.
findings.fix:
- Add baked two-bone chains for the front and back skirt (x_skirt_f_1-2, x_skirt_b_1-2), the hood-tail (x_tail_1-2) and the sash tongue.
- Drive them in the clip writer with a 2-4 frame lag and a damped overshoot, scaled up on Bound, dash, stops and death.
- Weight the front skirt to its own chain, not to the thighs.
- Re-key the death end with the right knee bent onto the floor.
- Add a pipeline gate that fails a clip when the lowest skinned body vertex is below -0.02 m.
findings.files: art/blender/fighters/ulkro.py (rig extras, skirt weights, clip_overrides run/death), art/blender/common/anim.py, art/blender/common/pipeline.py, art/out/fighters/ulkro/*.glb
findings.verifierNote:
Confirmed as a major, resting on the rigid knee-length skirt boarding in the run (the same class as kemdo-M4, ardit-M3 and nurrow-M3).

Two mitigations:
- The brief itself asks for the hood-tail to be a rigid shell (ulkro.md:56, ulkro.py:461-463), so the tail is a gauge gap rather than an off-brief defect.
- The 20 cm death sink is roster-wide (Ulkro is mid-pack, below ardit, ervet, marund and nurrow), and other verifiers rated it minor alone (ervet-m1, rishal-m3, nurrow-m3).

findings.title: Form and material finish: ribbed-tube sleeve and shin wraps, sole-less bulb boots, matte frosted dart heads, projected smudges on the tunic
findings.what:
- The sleeve and shin wraps are uniform horizontal rings that read as corrugated tubes. The concept draws overlapping diagonal bands.
- The boots are smooth bulbs with no sole, where the concept has shaped suede boots.
- The dawnglass leaf heads are frosted and matte, although the brief says dawnglass is glossy.
- The tunic carries projected dark strokes that ignore its folds.
- The quiver is a flat pale board with dark brush strokes and no bindings or lip.

All of this shows on the menu-stage 3D showcase and in every splash.
findings.evidence:
Viewed:
- _harness/_shots/closing_ulkro_three_row3a.png and closing_ulkro_three_row3b.png (crops of art/renders/fighters/ulkro/three_ulkro.png, 10-27 21:01, after the GLB): ring wraps, board quiver, bulb boots;
- closing_ulkro_splash_torso_legs_x3.png.

Against the concept (_design/concept/ulkro.webp): diagonal wraps and soled boots.

Brief: dawnglass is 'glossy but never emissive' (ulkro.md:7, :81).

The menu stage shows the 3D fighter large (src/ui/components/Portrait.tsx:112, src/ui/screens/draft.tsx:12).
findings.gauge: A LoL in-game model keeps crisp hand-painted form at close and gameplay range: wraps drawn as overlapping bands, boots with soles, glass with a tight specular that reads as glass even when small.
findings.fix:
- Re-sculpt the sleeve and shin wraps as overlapping diagonal bands of varied width, with tucked ends.
- Give the boots a shaped toe, a sole welt one value darker and suede breakup.
- Give the dawnglass a tight gloss lobe and a thin bright rim.
- Replace the projected tunic strokes with fold-aligned paint.
- Give the quiver case cord bindings, a stitched lip and fold-aligned linen paint instead of brush smears.
findings.files: art/blender/fighters/ulkro.py (sleeves/shins/boots/quiver sculpts, paint wrappers, crest_heads material), art/out/fighters/ulkro/*.glb
findings.verifierNote:
Partly refuted, severity kept.
- Pauldron colour: refuted. The match pauldron at L* 70-75 and 10-12 % saturation is the brief's stone #B3AEA2 (L* 71, 9 %, ulkro.md:80). It is pale stone on purpose, not a grey-box defect; only the thin plate form departs from the concept.
- Quiver shape: refuted. The concept's quiver is itself a pale linen-wrapped flat case (back view), not a tube. Only its finish (smears, no bindings) is at fault. The brief's 'leather tube' contradicts the concept.
- What stands: wraps, boots, glass and smudges on four limbs and the tunic. They are prominent in the splash and on the 3D menu stage, so this stays a major (as burdam-M2, hesmi-M2 and lisvel-M3 were), though it is the most borderline of the three.

findings.title: Skins are modest: Highrim is a paler sand, and Long Evening has no effect tint
findings.evidence:
_harness/_reports/closing_ulkro_verify_skin_delta_roster.txt (gameplay-camera row of three_<id>.png, dE76 over figure pixels):
- Ulkro standard: p50 6.8, 31 % of pixels above dE 10;
- deluxe: p50 8.0, 22 % above dE 20.

Roster standard-skin p50 runs 1.2-10.0, and Ardit, Ervet, Sukri, Tunlan and Vashil are lower than Ulkro.

vfxTint appears only in hesmi, nurrow, odrum, sukri and tunlan (content/skins/*.json). The Long Evening brief (_design/fighters/ulkro.md:156-170) does not ask for one.

Shot: _harness/_shots/closing_ulkro_skins_gamecam_x2.png.
findings.gauge: A LoL skin is nameable at the gameplay camera, and higher-tier skins usually recolour their effects.
findings.fix:
- Highrim: push the hood and sleeves to the named #CDBB9C with the wind-carved strata at a stronger value step, so the skin reads at the game camera.
- Long Evening: add a VALE-own vfxTint outside the reserved hue bands, for example a dusk plum, so its darts and Run-up trail carry the festival colour.
- The splash work is tracked under M1.
findings.verifierNote:
Downgraded to minor.
- owner_rulings.md:7 binds skins to material and palette changes, so 'only a recolour' is the standard, not a defect.
- Highrim's delta is mid-roster, and Long Evening is clearly distinct by its plum hood and fan.
- The missing vfxTint is not in the brief and is shared by 11 of 16 deluxe skins.
- The splash and portrait reuse is double-counted with M1.

findings.title: Verifier-added: the face has no living cue: an opaque wooden band over a linen wrap, a grin-like stripe at the game camera
findings.what:
The eye slit is a matte ink line along the band's bottom groove (ulkro.py:482-484, :1376-1378). In the portrait (shown in the HUD all match), the 128 px icon and the 48 and 26 px chips, the face is a brown bar over a pale wrapped oval, with no eye, glint or readable slit.

From the 52 degree camera, facing 0, the band, the dark gap and the pale wrap form a pale stripe between dark arcs that reads like a grin. That is not horror, a hockey mask or a mannequin; the wrap has folds and a nose.
findings.gauge: A masked or wrapped LoL champion still reads as someone looking at you at icon size: a lit or catch-lit eye line in the slit.
findings.fix:
- Open the slit into a slightly wider dark recess, about 8 mm.
- Put a warm honey-amber catch-light behind it, as owner ruling 2 does for Odrum's mask, so the eye line reads at 26-128 px.
- Tuck the wrap's top edge up under the band to close the dark gap that makes the grin stripe at the game camera.
findings.files: art/blender/fighters/ulkro.py (eyeband sculpt :476-485, carved-band paint :1376-1380, face wrap), art/out/fighters/ulkro/portrait.png, icon.png
findings.verifierNote: Minor, not major and not a blocker. It follows the approved concept, so it is treated like dunsom's face (downgraded) rather than hesmi-M1, where the model departed from its concept. Its game-camera read matches kemdo-v1, which was rated minor. It is the one sensitivity-adjacent item the reviewer did not weigh against the 'faces read as alive' ruling (owner_rulings.md:6).
